name: Doki Doki Vacation ~Kirameku Kisetsu no Naka de~
original_name: DOKIDOKIバケーション ～きらめく季節の中で～
source:
Dokidoki Vacation tells the story of a Japanese teenager called Junichi. High school is over, the summer vacation has begun. But due to the young man's uneasy relationship with his family and other circumstances, he cannot afford the vacation he was hoping for. So Junichi decides to find a job. He starts working in a book store, and soon realizes that feelings develop between him and Megumi, a girl who works in the same place. But what about the classmate Junichi was in love with before?..

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/dokidoki-vacation-kirameku-kisetsu-no-naka-de]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《心跳假期（Doki Doki Vacation）》讲述了日本少年润一的夏日物语。高中生涯画上句号，悠长的暑假正式开启；然而由于同家里关系紧张等诸多隐情，囊中羞涩的润一根本无力享受原本期盼的惬意假期，只得决定出门打工自食其力。入职一家书店后不久，他便发觉自己与同店打工的少女惠之间悄然滋生出朦胧情愫——可这样一来，润一昔日一直暗恋着的那位同班女生又该如何取舍……？

[摘自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/dokidoki-vacation-kirameku-kisetsu-no-naka-de]Moby Games[/url]]
